Almost all restaurants serving meat in Sharm El Sheikh use halal-slaughtered meat. This includes local Egyptian restaurants, shawarma shops, burger joints, seafood restaurants, and fast food outlets. You will not find pork on the menu at Egyptian-owned restaurants. Some international hotel restaurants and a small number of tourist-facing establishments may serve pork or pork-based products — these are rare and usually clearly labelled.
